summary: Full end-to-end validation of HomePage redesign (Smart Lights Demo with NoLights.png floorplan + CSS radial gradient overlays) and backend APIs. All 22 pytest backend tests pass, GET /api/quotations returns 200 (previous 500 bug confirmed fixed), GET /api/shop/products returns 200, /login redirects to /customer/login, and all six room lights toggle correctly on the image-based floorplan with proper overlay opacity and UI text state.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx is ~720 lines — long but acceptable; could be split (ImageFloorplan + RoomTile + sections) into separate components for maintainability.
ImageFloorplan renders 3 map()-overlay layers per room; fine performance-wise at 6 rooms but if scaled, consider single layered component per room.
useInView + demo auto-animation uses a ref array of timers (animTimers.current) — cleanup looks correct; good.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_-prefixed customers and a test customer test@inhaus.co.in during run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Lights Demo is image-based (NoLights.png + radial-gradient overlays with mix-blend-mode: screen). Overlay elements expose data-testid='light-overlay-{id}' (opacity 0 OFF, 1 ON). Room tiles: data-testid='room-tile-{id}', buttons 'room-toggle-{id}', plus 'all-on-btn' / 'all-off-btn'. Backend /api/quotations, /api/invoices, /api/shop/products all healthy. /login redirect verified.
